page.layout: One printed page showing only the tooled leather binding of the book: a decorative frame with a central panel bearing a coat of arms and ornamental tooling. No text block is printed on this scan.
page.notes: The scan shows the embossed leather cover of the book, not a printed page. The central panel contains a heraldic shield divided into quarters with tooled figures (lions, crosses, a chevron-like device) and an ornamental crest above; the frame carries foliate scrollwork. There is no printed text, running head, page number, catchword or signature to transcribe.
